name: Handmade Potato Gnocchi with Mild Pomodoro Sauce
whyItWorks: Handmade potato dumplings are tender, pillow-soft, and remarkably easy to chew and digest. Coated in a smooth, strained San Marzano tomato pomodoro sauce without chunky skins, it provides gentle Italian comfort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the pomodoro sauce to be smooth without whole garlic cloves or crushed chili flakes. Add light grated Parmigiano Reggiano if tolerated.
